in_hebrew.name: Jamnis
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Jamnis הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Greek word 'doron', meaning 'gift'. In Christian belief, a child is considered a precious gift from God. In the Bible, children are often symbolic of new beginnings and hope.

in_greek.long_meaning: Jamnis είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. From the Greek word 'doron', meaning 'gift'. In Christian belief, a child is considered a precious gift from God. In the Bible, children are often symbolic of new beginnings and hope.

in_latin.name: Jamnis
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat God's gift
in_latin.long_meaning: Jamnis est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. From the Greek word 'doron', meaning 'gift'. In Christian belief, a child is considered a precious gift from God. In the Bible, children are often symbolic of new beginnings and hope.
